proof_limit: The local canonical conversation query timed out while resolving the advisory-panel transcript. Panel obligations are therefore bound to their settled expressions in the approved plan; the six redteam IDs and descriptions are retained from the active task transcript but lack a separate archive artifact binding.

findings.statement: A Lattice-owned port allocator or resurrected portctl CLI would contradict Outport's sole service-authority contract.
findings.independent_oracle: Outport JSON resolution, launchd process ownership, and the bound listener agree on one Lattice identity and port.
findings.false_mutation: Run Lattice on a port different from Outport's lattice allocation and require doctor plus acceptance to fail.

findings.statement: Native continuation was specified while model-runner rejected every session policy except fresh execution.
findings.independent_oracle: Authenticated provider acceptance proves a session ID, a qualified resume or fork command, and rejection across model, workspace, or authority changes.
findings.false_mutation: Reuse a native session after changing workspace or permissions and require eligibility to fail.

findings.statement: Making roles optional without a typed actor contract and restartable migration would corrupt existing role-bound drafts and invocations.
findings.independent_oracle: A hand-authored direct context contains no role bytes; an exact copy of the schema-7 runtime database migrates with identical manifest bytes, row counts, append chain, and foreign keys.
findings.false_mutation: Attach a role session to a direct actor or mutate a direct v4 manifest into a role-bound invocation and require both storage and the independent reader to reject it.

findings.statement: Freestyle UI verbs would become divergent kernel state machines, and fan-out cannot truthfully share one route-specific manifest.
findings.independent_oracle: Every gesture compiles to one generic batch contract while each child retains its own capability and compiled-request manifest.
findings.false_mutation: Remove one fan-out child's capability record or give siblings different semantic assemblies and require the batch oracle to fail.

findings.statement: The remediation could duplicate already-working context delta, Slate slices, route selection, and trailhead machinery instead of exposing it coherently.
findings.independent_oracle: The cockpit and Slate acceptance paths resolve through the existing ledger identities and endpoints without copied transcript state or a second projection authority.
findings.false_mutation: Replace a saved Slate query with copied transcript bytes or make an older trailhead unreachable and require acceptance to fail.

findings.statement: Generic contradiction or provider-opacity warnings are not deterministic execution boundaries and would produce arbitrary interruption ceremony.
findings.independent_oracle: Confirmation reasons derive only from exact authority expansion, operator-uninitiated loss or transformation, or a weakened qualified isolation profile.
findings.false_mutation: Plant a hidden omission or new write authority and require one-action execution to stop while an explicitly selected provider route proceeds without redundant confirmation.

findings.statement: Ordinary use must open into response and composer; roles, workflows, and raw graph configuration are secondary tools rather than prerequisites.
findings.independent_oracle: Browser acceptance completes the freestyle path from a blank project without opening a role, workflow, graph, or manifest panel.
findings.false_mutation: Require role creation before first send and require browser acceptance to fail.

findings.statement: Side quests, fan-out, fan-in, cross-feed, and return must be available one edge at a time without preplotting the graph.
findings.independent_oracle: A browser operator authors the complete freestyle lattice conversationally and resumes any dormant trailhead after restart.
findings.false_mutation: Hide a dormant branch after pagination or require a predefined workflow for a side quest and require acceptance to fail.

findings.statement: Exact observable context and its delta must remain continuously inspectable without turning every ordinary send into a mandatory preflight ceremony.
findings.independent_oracle: Independent reconstruction matches provider bytes and the tray distinguishes added, removed, transformed, omitted, unchanged, and provider-opaque material.
findings.false_mutation: Relabel a summary as verbatim or hide an omission and require the independent reader or browser oracle to fail.

findings.statement: Side-quest episodes and Slate topics are overlapping concern-backed slices, never exclusive containers or copied conversations.
findings.independent_oracle: One invocation participates in several episodes and a live Slate slice updates through concern edges while every claim resolves to its canonical object.
findings.false_mutation: Make an episode own an invocation exclusively or persist transcript bytes in Slate and require the slice oracle to fail.

findings.statement: Lattice and AXISVI remain independent nested repositories without gitmodule or parent-pointer bookkeeping.
findings.independent_oracle: Git topology reports an ignored ordinary nested repository and no Lattice gitlink or .gitmodules entry in AXISVI.
findings.false_mutation: Add a Lattice gitlink or submodule declaration and require the topology contract to fail.

findings.statement: Lattice must remain recoverable when Panels, the browser UI, a provider, or a development checkout fails.
findings.independent_oracle: Outport resolution, launchd restart, pinned runtime upgrade rollback, database and blob diagnosis, snapshot restore, and post-restore continuation all pass independently.
findings.false_mutation: Remove a referenced blob from a snapshot or break the active runtime symlink and require doctor or restore to report failure rather than success.

findings.statement: The generated pytest launcher still points at the removed loom checkout, and uv can panic before test admission on the current machine.
findings.independent_oracle: A clean pinned installation runs the CLI, unit suite, and browser suite without editable paths or pre-rename shebangs.
findings.false_mutation: Embed the removed axis/chariots/loom path in an installed launcher and require doctor plus installation acceptance to fail.

findings.statement: AXISVI root status cannot currently complete because the Git LFS clean filter cannot create its temporary file.
findings.independent_oracle: Root git status and an LFS clean-filter round trip succeed without changing tracked bytes.
findings.false_mutation: Deny writes to the LFS temporary directory and require the operational check to report degraded rather than clean.
